scientific_integrity: A complete symbolic sign argument proves all parameter ranges; finite rational matrix checks are supporting tests rather than an infinite proof. Publication priority against uncatalogued specialist work remains uncertain.
scientific_limitations: The classification applies to autonomous one-way cycles with at least five states, strictly positive rates and the unmodified linear RK4 endpoint; it does not assert intermediate-stage, nonlinear, nonautonomous or floating-point positivity. Sharp limiting gain is a supremum rather than an attained value.
title: Exact RK4 positivity on heterogeneous directed cycles and a sharp CFL gain
